topic: Inventory data structure and form updates
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on updating the inventory system. [me] suggested assisting by modifying two JSON files—the schema and form description—to facilitate data offloading to the inventory section. To test this, [me] recommended adding a separate tab to the form for new fields, noting that the current setup safely saves all non-empty fields.

Regarding the structure, it was confirmed that the system currently saves data according to the defined schema and that the existing flat structure is suitable because values can be easily retrieved in CH (presumably referring to a specific platform or tool). [p1] stated they would attempt the modifications themselves.
decisions: The current JSON structure will remain flat for now, as it allows easy retrieval of values in CH.
action_items: [p1] will attempt to modify the form and data structure based on the discussion.
